blocks.zh: Sections 1–3: Introduction, Scope & Principles of Quality Risk Management｜導論、範圍與品質風險管理原則
blocks.en: Sections 1–3: Introduction, Scope & Principles of Quality Risk Management

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標 Learning Objectives
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解 品質風險管理（QRM） 的本質定義：風險 = 危害發生機率 × 危害嚴重程度，以及主觀性如何影響共識達成
blocks.en: Understand the essential definition of quality risk management (QRM): risk = probability of occurrence of harm × severity of that harm, and how subjectivity affects reaching consensus

blocks.zh: 掌握 Q9(R1) 最重要的修訂亮點：產品可及性（product availability） 被正式納入病患保護的範疇
blocks.en: Grasp the most important highlight of the Q9(R1) revision: product availability is now formally included within the scope of patient protection

blocks.zh: 理解第一原則：風險評估應以科學知識為基礎，最終連結到病患保護
blocks.en: Understand the first principle: risk evaluation should be based on scientific knowledge and ultimately linked to the protection of the patient

blocks.zh: 掌握第二原則：QRM 的投入程度、正式化程度與文件要求應與風險程度相稱（commensurate）——這是 R1 版的關鍵新概念
blocks.en: Grasp the second principle: the level of effort, formality and documentation of QRM should be commensurate with the level of risk. This is the key new concept in R1

blocks.zh: 了解 QRM 在 CDMO 實務中如何作為客戶風險評估與製程決策的系統性工具
blocks.en: Understand how QRM serves in CDMO practice as a systematic tool for client risk assessments and process decisions

blocks.zh: Section 1 — Introduction（前三段）：風險的本質、主觀性與病患保護
blocks.en: Section 1 — Introduction (first three paragraphs): the nature of risk, subjectivity and patient protection

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念：風險的定義
blocks.en: Core concept: the definition of risk

blocks.zh: Risk（風險）= Probability of harm（危害發生機率）× Severity of harm（危害嚴重程度）
blocks.en: Risk = Probability of harm × Severity of harm

blocks.zh: 這是 ICH Q9 對風險的官方定義，也是所有 QRM 工具（FMEA、HAZOP、FTA 等）的計算基礎。注意：許多工具還會加入第三個維度——Detectability（可偵測性），例如 FMEA 的 RPN = Severity × Occurrence × Detection。
blocks.en: This is the official ICH Q9 definition of risk and the basis for the calculations in all QRM tools (FMEA, HAZOP, FTA, etc.). Note that many tools add a third dimension, detectability; for example, the FMEA RPN = Severity × Occurrence × Detection.

blocks.zh: 但 Q9 本身只定義兩個維度，是刻意保留的簡潔框架，避免強制要求特定方法。
blocks.en: Q9 itself defines only two dimensions. This is a deliberately simple framework that avoids mandating any particular method.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：保險精算師的視角
blocks.en: Analogy: the insurance actuary's view

blocks.zh: 風險 = 機率 × 嚴重程度，這和保險公司計算保費的邏輯完全相同。一棟位於地震帶的化工廠（高機率 + 高嚴重度）保費遠高於平地倉庫。
blocks.en: Risk = probability × severity follows exactly the same logic insurers use to calculate premiums. A chemical plant located in an earthquake zone (high probability + high severity) pays far higher premiums than a warehouse on flat ground.

blocks.zh: QRM 的難題在於：不同的利害關係人對同一件事的機率估計和嚴重程度判斷往往不同。一位製程工程師可能認為某混合步驟風險低（因為他們天天做），但品保人員或法規主管可能看到更高風險（因為他們見過更多偏差案例）。這就是「主觀性問題」——而 R1 版特別強調要「管理並最小化主觀性」。
blocks.en: The difficulty in QRM is that different stakeholders often estimate the probability and judge the severity of the same event differently. A process engineer may consider a mixing step low risk (because they run it every day), while QA or regulatory affairs may see higher risk (because they have seen more deviation cases). This is the "subjectivity problem", and R1 specifically stresses the need to "manage and minimize subjectivity".

blocks.zh: R1 版新增重點：產品可及性 = 病患保護議題
blocks.en: New emphasis in R1: product availability = a patient protection issue

blocks.zh: Q9(R1) 在第一節就已埋下重要修訂種子：
blocks.en: Q9(R1) plants the seed of an important revision as early as the first section:

blocks.zh: 這在 2005 年原版 Q9 中是沒有的。R1 版明確指出：如果製造/品質問題導致藥品缺貨（shortage），造成病患無法取得藥品，這同樣是病患保護問題。COVID-19 期間全球藥品供應鏈危機正是這一修訂的背景之一。
blocks.en: This was not in the original 2005 Q9. R1 states explicitly that if a manufacturing or quality problem causes a drug shortage so that patients cannot obtain their medicine, this is also a patient protection issue. The global drug supply chain crisis during COVID-19 was one of the drivers of this revision.

blocks.zh: 對製藥廠與 CDMO 的實務意涵：供應鏈風險管理、備料策略、關鍵原料的 sole-source 問題，都應該被納入 QRM 的視野。
blocks.en: Practical implications for pharmaceutical manufacturers and CDMOs: supply chain risk management, stock-holding strategies and sole-source issues for critical materials should all come within the scope of QRM.

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務應用：QRM 作為多方共識工具
blocks.en: CDMO practice: QRM as a tool for multi-party consensus

blocks.zh: CDMO 同時服務多個客戶，不同客戶對於同一製程風險的接受程度往往不同。例如，某一個混合時間偏差，客戶 A（腫瘤藥，無替代品）可能要求立即停線調查；客戶 B（OTC 保健品）可能接受繼續生產並做額外測試。
blocks.en: A CDMO serves multiple clients at once, and different clients often accept different levels of risk for the same process. For example, for a given mixing-time deviation, Client A (an oncology drug with no alternative) may demand an immediate line stop and investigation, while Client B (an OTC health product) may accept continued production with additional testing.

blocks.zh: 建立一套正式的 QRM 框架（Risk Policy + Risk Criteria），讓決策有據可循，才能在多客戶環境下維持一致性，也能在客戶審計時清楚說明為何做出某個決定。
blocks.en: Establishing a formal QRM framework (risk policy + risk criteria) makes decisions traceable, keeps them consistent in a multi-client environment, and lets you explain clearly during client audits why a given decision was made.

blocks.zh: Section 1 — Introduction（後四段）：主動式 QRM、數位化新風險、正式化概念
blocks.en: Section 1 — Introduction (last four paragraphs): proactive QRM, new risks from digitalization, the concept of formality

blocks.zh: 主動式 vs. 被動式 QRM
blocks.en: Proactive vs. reactive QRM

blocks.zh: Q9(R1) 強調 Proactive（主動式） QRM 的重要性。對比如下：
blocks.en: Q9(R1) stresses the importance of proactive QRM. The contrast is as follows:

blocks.zh: 被動式（Reactive）：發生偏差 → 做 CAPA → 做 risk assessment 決定要不要放行。風險評估是「救火」。
blocks.en: Reactive: a deviation occurs → CAPA → a risk assessment to decide whether to release. Risk assessment is "firefighting".

blocks.zh: 主動式（Proactive）：開發階段就用 FMEA/HAZOP 識別潛在失效模式 → 在設計製程和控制策略時就把這些風險控制進去 → 商業生產時出問題的機率大幅降低。
blocks.en: Proactive: during development, use FMEA/HAZOP to identify potential failure modes → build controls for these risks into the process design and control strategy → the probability of problems in commercial production drops substantially.

blocks.zh: 主動式 QRM 還包括根本原因分析（RCA），不只是找出直接原因，還要找出系統性的根本原因（包括人為因素），才能真正防止再發。
blocks.en: Proactive QRM also includes root cause analysis (RCA): the aim is not only to find the direct cause but also the systemic root cause (including human factors), so that recurrence can truly be prevented.

blocks.zh: R1 版新增重點：數位化與新興技術的雙刃劍
blocks.en: New emphasis in R1: digitalization and emerging technologies as a double-edged sword

blocks.zh: 這是 Q9(R1) 相較於 2005 年版的另一個重要新增段落。當時沒有大規模的 AI/ML 應用、沒有 Industry 4.0、沒有先進連續製造。
blocks.en: This is another important addition in Q9(R1) compared with the 2005 version. At that time there was no large-scale use of AI/ML, no Industry 4.0 and no advanced continuous manufacturing.

blocks.zh: R1 版承認新技術可以「降低風險」（例如 PAT 即時監測取代盲目放行），但同時也承認新技術會「帶入新風險」——例如：
blocks.en: R1 acknowledges that new technologies can "reduce risk" (for example, real-time PAT monitoring replacing blind release), but also that they "introduce new risks", for example:

blocks.zh: AI 演算法的訓練資料偏差（data bias）
blocks.en: Training-data bias in AI algorithms

blocks.zh: 電腦化系統的數據完整性風險（data integrity）
blocks.en: Data integrity risks in computerized systems

blocks.zh: 先進連續製造的製程監控失效模式
blocks.en: Process-monitoring failure modes in advanced continuous manufacturing

blocks.zh: 雲端資料管理的網路安全風險
blocks.en: Cybersecurity risks in cloud data management

blocks.zh: 因此，對新技術的驗證（validation）和技術轉移（technology transfer）應特別施以 QRM。
blocks.en: Therefore, QRM should be applied with particular care to the validation and technology transfer of new technologies.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：正式化（Formality）概念
blocks.en: Analogy: the concept of formality

blocks.zh: 想像你是一位外科醫生。更換手術室燈泡（低風險）→ 你不需要召開多學科會議、填 10 頁風險評估表，打個電話給設備組就好。但如果是引進一套新的機器人輔助手術系統（高風險）→ 你就需要正式的驗證計劃、培訓紀錄、臨床試驗、設備確認文件……
blocks.en: Imagine you are a surgeon. Replacing a light bulb in the operating room (low risk) → you do not need to convene a multidisciplinary meeting or fill in a 10-page risk assessment form; a phone call to the facilities team is enough. But introducing a new robot-assisted surgery system (high risk) → you need a formal validation plan, training records, clinical trials, equipment qualification documents, and so on.

blocks.zh: 這就是「正式化與風險程度相稱」的精髓：把有限的資源集中到真正需要嚴格管理的高風險問題上，而不是對所有事情一律用最繁複的程序。這是 R1 版在 Introduction 中就開宗明義說明的新觀念，並在 Section 5 詳細展開。
blocks.en: This is the essence of "formality commensurate with the level of risk": concentrate limited resources on the high-risk issues that really need rigorous management, rather than applying the most elaborate procedure to everything. R1 introduces this new concept right at the start of the Introduction and develops it in detail in Section 5.

blocks.zh: 重要警告：QRM 不是「合理化不合規行為」的工具
blocks.en: Important warning: QRM is not a tool for rationalizing non-compliance

blocks.zh: 最後一段是相當嚴肅的警告：
blocks.en: The last paragraph is a serious warning:

blocks.zh: 現實中確實有廠商用「我們做了風險評估，結論是可以接受」來為不合規操作辯護——例如某些 GDP 要求、資料完整性規定、無菌製造控制要求。這種做法是不被 ICH 認可的。QRM 是幫助你做出更好決策的工具，而不是繞過法規的藉口。
blocks.en: In reality, some companies do defend non-compliant practices with "we did a risk assessment and concluded it is acceptable", for example against certain GDP requirements, data integrity rules or sterile manufacturing control requirements. ICH does not endorse this practice. QRM is a tool to help you make better decisions, not an excuse to bypass regulations.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 一家 CDMO 的製程工程師說：「這個步驟我們做了幾百批了，很成熟，不需要做風險評估。」這個說法有什麼問題？從 Q9(R1) 的角度如何回應？
blocks.en: A CDMO process engineer says: "We have run this step for hundreds of batches; it is mature and does not need a risk assessment." What is wrong with this statement? How would you respond from the perspective of Q9(R1)?

blocks.zh: Q9(R1) 提到 QRM 可以「beneficially affect the extent and level of direct regulatory oversight」。請解釋這句話對一家想爭取 FDA PAI（Pre-Approval Inspection）順利通過的藥廠意味著什麼。
blocks.en: Q9(R1) states that QRM can "beneficially affect the extent and level of direct regulatory oversight". Explain what this means for a manufacturer that wants to pass an FDA PAI (Pre-Approval Inspection) smoothly.

blocks.zh: 如果你的公司正在導入 AI 製程控制系統，根據 R1 版，你應該在哪些環節施以 QRM？請列出至少三個關鍵點。
blocks.en: If your company is introducing an AI process control system, at which points should you apply QRM according to R1? List at least three key points.

blocks.zh: Section 2 — Scope｜適用範圍
blocks.en: Section 2 — Scope

blocks.zh: 範圍解析：Q9 覆蓋的四大面向
blocks.en: Scope analysis: the four areas covered by Q9

blocks.zh: 雖然 Scope 只有一段，但其涵蓋範圍非常廣泛：
blocks.en: Although the Scope is only one paragraph, the coverage is very broad:

blocks.zh: Development（開發）：處方開發、製程開發、分析方法開發、穩定性研究——QRM 應從最早期就介入
blocks.en: Development: formulation development, process development, analytical method development and stability studies. QRM should be involved from the earliest stage

blocks.zh: Manufacturing（製造）：商業批次生產、製程確效、變更控制、偏差處理——QRM 是日常品質決策的核心
blocks.en: Manufacturing: commercial batch production, process validation, change control and deviation handling. QRM is at the core of day-to-day quality decisions

blocks.zh: Distribution（配銷）：冷鏈管理、GDP 合規、倉儲與運輸條件監控——這也在 Q9 範圍內，許多人忽略了這一點
blocks.en: Distribution: cold chain management, GDP compliance, and monitoring of storage and transport conditions. These are also within the scope of Q9, a point many people overlook

blocks.zh: Inspection and Submission/Review（查廠與申請審查）：法規機關查廠前的風險評估、CTD 申請文件的風險描述——QRM 是雙向的，監管者也在用它
blocks.en: Inspection and Submission/Review: risk assessment by regulatory authorities before inspections, and risk descriptions in CTD dossiers. QRM works both ways; regulators use it too

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務應用：QRM 適用於整個委外鏈
blocks.en: CDMO practice: QRM applies across the whole outsourcing chain

blocks.zh: CDMO 不只是製造，還涉及原料採購、成品配送協助等，整條服務鏈都在 Q9 的範圍內。一個常見的盲點是：CDMO 對客戶的放行測試（QC）做了完整 QRM，但對冷鏈運輸（如需 2-8°C 的生物製劑）的風險評估不足，導致配送環節出現品質事件。Q9(R1) 的 Scope 明確告訴我們：從原料到病患，每一個環節都需要 QRM 的覆蓋。
blocks.en: A CDMO does more than manufacture; it also deals with raw material procurement, support for finished product distribution and so on, and the entire service chain falls within the scope of Q9. A common blind spot: a CDMO performs full QRM on its client's release testing (QC) but gives too little risk assessment to cold chain transport (for example, biologics requiring 2-8°C), leading to quality events in the distribution step. The Scope of Q9(R1) tells us clearly that every link from raw material to patient needs QRM coverage.

blocks.zh: Section 3 — Principles of Quality Risk Management｜品質風險管理兩大原則
blocks.en: Section 3 — Principles of Quality Risk Management: the two principles

blocks.zh: 第一原則深度解析：科學知識 + 病患保護
blocks.en: First principle in depth: scientific knowledge + patient protection

blocks.zh: 「以科學知識為基礎」——意味著 QRM 不是靠直覺、不是靠資歷，而是靠：
blocks.en: "Based on scientific knowledge" means QRM relies not on intuition or seniority, but on:

blocks.zh: 毒理學數據（例如某雜質的 PDE 限度）
blocks.en: Toxicological data (for example, the PDE limit of an impurity)

blocks.zh: 製程理解（CPP 與 CQA 的關係）
blocks.en: Process understanding (the relationship between CPPs and CQAs)

blocks.zh: 文獻資料與歷史批次數據
blocks.en: Literature data and historical batch data

blocks.zh: 監管機構的指引（ICH M7、Q3C 等）
blocks.en: Regulatory guidance (ICH M7, Q3C, etc.)

blocks.zh: 「最終連結到病患保護」——這是所有 QRM 決策的北極星。當你在做風險接受度決定時，問問自己：「這個決定，如果病患和他的醫生看到，他們會同意嗎？」
blocks.en: "Ultimately linked to the protection of the patient" is the North Star of every QRM decision. When deciding on risk acceptance, ask yourself: "If the patient and their doctor saw this decision, would they agree with it?"

blocks.zh: 括號注意事項（R1 新增）：明確說明「Risk to quality includes product availability impacts」——短缺（shortage）本身就是一種對病患的傷害，特別是針對唯一療法的藥品（如某些抗癌藥）。
blocks.en: Note in parentheses (new in R1): it states explicitly that "Risk to quality includes product availability impacts". A shortage is itself a harm to patients, especially for drugs that are the only available therapy (such as certain anticancer drugs).

blocks.zh: 第二原則深度解析：相稱性原則（Commensurate）
blocks.en: Second principle in depth: the commensurate principle

blocks.zh: 這是 R1 版最重要的新貢獻之一。「Commensurate（相稱）」這個詞意味著：
blocks.en: This is one of the most important new contributions of R1. The word "commensurate" means:

blocks.zh: 高風險 → 高投入：無菌注射劑的培養基灌裝（media fill）——需要全面的 FMEA、完整文件、多學科團隊參與
blocks.en: High risk → high effort: media fill for a sterile injectable requires a comprehensive FMEA, complete documentation and a multidisciplinary team

blocks.zh: 低風險 → 低投入：更換一個非關鍵的辦公用品供應商——可能只需要一個簡短的風險評估記錄，不需要正式 QRM 程序
blocks.en: Low risk → low effort: changing a non-critical office supplies vendor may need only a brief risk assessment record, not a formal QRM procedure

blocks.zh: 中等風險 → 中等投入：調整某非關鍵製程參數的操作範圍——需要書面風險評估，但不需要召集完整的多學科審查委員會
blocks.en: Medium risk → medium effort: adjusting the operating range of a non-critical process parameter needs a written risk assessment, but not a full multidisciplinary review committee

blocks.zh: 三個維度的「相稱」：Effort（投入工作量）+ Formality（正式化程度）+ Documentation（文件化程度），三者都應與風險等級掛鉤。
blocks.en: Being "commensurate" applies in three dimensions: Effort + Formality + Documentation. All three should be tied to the risk level.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：相稱性原則就像「工具箱選工具」
blocks.en: Analogy: the commensurate principle is like "choosing tools from a toolbox"

blocks.zh: 想像你是一位水電工。鎖螺絲用螺絲起子，不需要用電動鑽；但鑽穿混凝土牆，你就不能只用螺絲起子。選錯工具不只浪費時間，還可能損壞東西。
blocks.en: Imagine you are a plumber or electrician. You use a screwdriver to drive screws, not a power drill; but to drill through a concrete wall, a screwdriver will not do. Choosing the wrong tool wastes time and may also damage things.

blocks.zh: QRM 工具也是一樣：
blocks.en: The same goes for QRM tools:

blocks.zh: 輕微偏差（漏記一個時間點）→ 直接書面記錄 + 品保主管簽核，不需要 FMEA
blocks.en: Minor deviation (a missed time entry) → a direct written record + QA manager sign-off, no FMEA needed

blocks.zh: 批次失敗（無菌測試不合格）→ 需要完整 RCA + 跨部門 risk review + CAPA + 監管報告
blocks.en: Batch failure (failed sterility test) → needs full RCA + cross-functional risk review + CAPA + regulatory reporting

blocks.zh: 新工廠設計 → 需要完整 HAZOP + FTA + 多輪風險評估，耗時數月
blocks.en: New facility design → needs full HAZOP + FTA + multiple rounds of risk assessment, taking months

blocks.zh: 「相稱性」讓你把對的精力放在對的地方，而不是所有事情都用最重的程序，導致資源耗盡、重要風險反而被輕視。
blocks.en: "Commensurate" lets you put the right effort in the right place, instead of using the heaviest procedure for everything, which exhausts resources and leads to important risks being underestimated.

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務應用：建立 Risk Tiering 分級制度
blocks.en: CDMO practice: establishing a risk tiering system

blocks.zh: 根據相稱性原則，建議 CDMO 建立正式的 Risk Tiering（風險分層）制度，將所有需要 QRM 的場景分為三個等級：
blocks.en: Based on the commensurate principle, a CDMO should establish a formal risk tiering system that divides all situations needing QRM into three levels:

blocks.zh: Tier 1（高風險）：無菌批次失敗、病患傷害報告、OOS 調查、新產品首批商業批次 → 完整 QRM 程序，多學科團隊，正式文件，可能需向客戶/監管機構通報
blocks.en: Tier 1 (high risk): sterile batch failure, patient harm reports, OOS investigations, first commercial batch of a new product → full QRM procedure, multidisciplinary team, formal documentation, possible notification to the client or regulator

blocks.zh: Tier 2（中等風險）：非關鍵製程參數調整、供應商變更、設備小改 → 書面風險評估，品保審核，更新相關 SOP
blocks.en: Tier 2 (medium risk): adjustment of non-critical process parameters, supplier changes, minor equipment modifications → written risk assessment, QA review, update of related SOPs

blocks.zh: Tier 3（低風險）：定期設備維保、非製程用辦公用品採購 → 簡短記錄，作業員確認即可
blocks.en: Tier 3 (low risk): routine equipment maintenance, purchase of non-process office supplies → brief record, operator confirmation is enough

blocks.zh: 這個分層制度本身就是 Q9(R1) 第二原則（相稱性）的最佳實踐，並在客戶審計和法規查廠時展現系統性 QRM 文化。
blocks.en: This tiering system is itself a best practice for the second principle of Q9(R1) (commensurate), and demonstrates a systematic QRM culture during client audits and regulatory inspections.

blocks.zh: 一家藥廠的唯一降壓藥（市場上無替代品）因為 API 供應商品質問題面臨停產。根據 Q9(R1) 第一原則，如何論證這個供應鏈風險屬於「病患保護」議題？監管機關（如 FDA）在此情境下的立場是什麼？
blocks.en: A manufacturer's only antihypertensive drug (no alternative on the market) faces production stoppage because of an API supplier quality problem. Based on the first principle of Q9(R1), how would you argue that this supply chain risk is a "patient protection" issue? What is the position of regulators (such as FDA) in this scenario?

blocks.zh: 你的 QA 主管要求對所有變更（包括更換辦公室印表機紙張供應商）都做完整的 FMEA。從第二原則（相稱性）角度，你如何說服主管修訂這個要求？你會提出什麼替代方案？
blocks.en: Your QA manager requires a full FMEA for every change (including changing the supplier of office printer paper). From the perspective of the second principle (commensurate), how would you persuade the manager to revise this requirement? What alternative would you propose?

blocks.zh: 如果一個 QRM 風險評估的結論是「風險可接受，不需要採取控制措施」，但這個做法在現行 GMP 法規下是不被允許的，這樣做對嗎？請引用 Q9(R1) 原文支持你的答案。
blocks.en: If a QRM risk assessment concludes "the risk is acceptable and no control measures are needed", but this practice is not permitted under current GMP regulations, is it right to do so? Cite the Q9(R1) text to support your answer.

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: QRM 的定義基礎：風險 = 機率 × 嚴重程度；但主觀性使共識難以達成，因此 Q9(R1) 特別強調主觀性管理（詳見 Section 5.3）
blocks.en: Definitional basis of QRM: risk = probability × severity; but subjectivity makes consensus hard to reach, so Q9(R1) places particular emphasis on managing subjectivity (see Section 5.3)

blocks.zh: R1 版最大亮點之一：「病患保護」的範疇已擴展至產品可及性（availability）風險——供應鏈短缺 = 病患傷害，廠商與 CDMO 的供應鏈風險管理責任因此提升
blocks.en: One of the biggest highlights of R1: the scope of "patient protection" now extends to product availability risk. Supply chain shortage = patient harm, which raises the supply chain risk management responsibilities of manufacturers and CDMOs

blocks.zh: 主動式 QRM：從開發階段就識別和控制潛在風險；不是出了問題才做風險評估，而是讓良好的設計從源頭減少問題發生
blocks.en: Proactive QRM: identify and control potential risks from the development stage; do not wait for a problem before doing a risk assessment, but let good design reduce problems at the source

blocks.zh: 數位化雙刃劍：新技術降低某些風險，但引入新風險；AI、連續製造、電腦化系統的設計/驗證/轉移應接受 QRM
blocks.en: Digitalization as a double-edged sword: new technologies reduce some risks but introduce new ones; the design, validation and transfer of AI, continuous manufacturing and computerized systems should be subject to QRM

blocks.zh: 第一原則：風險評估以科學知識為基礎，最終連結病患保護（含可及性）
blocks.en: First principle: risk evaluation is based on scientific knowledge and ultimately linked to patient protection (including availability)

blocks.zh: 第二原則（相稱性）：投入程度、正式化程度、文件化程度應與風險等級相稱——這是 R1 版的核心新貢獻，也是有效率地運用有限品保資源的關鍵
blocks.en: Second principle (commensurate): the level of effort, formality and documentation should be commensurate with the level of risk. This is the core new contribution of R1 and the key to using limited QA resources efficiently

blocks.zh: QRM 的邊界：QRM 輔助合規，但不能用來合理化不合規的做法；「我做了風險評估」不能成為違反法規的免責盾牌
blocks.en: The boundary of QRM: QRM supports compliance but cannot be used to rationalize non-compliant practices; "I did a risk assessment" is not a shield for violating regulations
